{{Quote|You are part of the greatest navy ever assembled. The might of the Empires rests on the military &mdash; and the Imperial Navy embodies the most elite and trusted segment of that power.|Fleet Admiral Holt|<ref name="ISB" />}}
'''Holt''' was a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in its [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], in which the [[Imperial Officer Corps/Legends|officer]] gave an indoctrination speech to [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] at the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Naval Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]].

He was a member of the prestigious [[Holt family]].<ref name="TEGtW-7">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>
